svg.metadata: Ferrosift investor review v01; model-derived HLR and solid sections; geometry mm; A3 landscape; General arrangement
svg.text: Proposed PCB-rich recovery module / depolluted, liberated, dry screened WEEE / geometry only
SIDE / actual assembly, covers retained / scale per drawing / 1:25
Side scale 1:25; nominal floor z=0. Feed and discharge hardware are concept selections.
PLAN / same solid assembly, orthographic +Z view / 1:25
One airjet target/balance split; a separate balance-path gate
x follows belt travel; y is transverse; z is height above
floor. Inlet x=0 and lip x=3000 are provisional coordination
The sensing datum is 25 mm before the enclosure edge. The
1250 mm tracking distance starts at x=1750, not x=1775.
STEP-derived views show packaging and mechanical intent.
Strength, wear, drive sizing, guarding and component
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
